title: Bar Drop Glacier Mint 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Glacier Mint offers a brisk and deeply refreshing vape that focuses entirely on clean, botanical notes. The profile features the sweet, herbal taste of fresh Mint, delivering a bright and aromatic foundation. This is enhanced by an intensely cool finish, creating a frosty sensation that clears the palate. The double-concentrated recipe ensures this minty profile remains consistently crisp and vibrant throughout the day. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
